newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends strong on freeze, pulls Brent up.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends strong on freeze, pulls Brent up.

text.p: IPE gas oil closed $6 a tonne firmer and at its session high on Monday, propelled by strong demand for heating oil in Europe where a severe cold snap looked set to continue, brokers said.
"Gas oil held its ground despite early profit-taking in the U.S. and rallied into the close," said a broker.

Forecasters said the icy conditions, which have claimed at least 90 lives and brought snow as far south as the Mediterranean island of Corsica, may continue until late this week bringing heavy snowfalls and below normal temperatures.
Jan IPE gas oil ended at $223.00 a tonne.
"The cold weather has obviously helped gas oil. We're seeing good German buying, both in physicals and futures," said a broker.
The strength on gas oil markets pulled Brent higher and off mid-afternoon lows touched after a spell of profit-taking in U.S. markets took some of the shine off the early European rally.
Feb Brent crude was trading at $23.79 a barrel at 1810 GMT, up 37 cents on the day and well above the low of $23.55 posted shortly after NYMEX trading began.
